query: Every quarter I paste our metrics into the QBR slide template and have the model tidy it up. Help me be far more ambitious with it here - what should I be asking it for instead?

We think churn is an onboarding problem and I asked the model to summarise our churn dashboard. How would a top data scientist push the model further - raw event logs, real statistical methods, and something other than the model that proves the answer?
I'm rebuilding my personal homepage with an agent. Which other fields, specialists or tools should I pull in so this is more ambitious than a template refresh?
Rewrite this prompt so it's clearer and better structured for ChatGPT: 'write blog post kubernetes security make it good, not too long'
Go deeper on this review of the retry loop in client.go - check the backoff cap and the error handling too, not just naming.
Critique the reasoning in this paragraph: 'Models amplify the self-efficacy gap, so people who believe in AI will out-earn those who don't.'
